text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
I want to race right now! I wanna run~! 
Isn't there anything available?!
choice_data_list: What about cheering for Ruby and Miracle!?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
During the summer training camp, she was 
supposed to have decided not to run in the 
race so she could wholeheartedly cheer at 
the Sprinters Stakes, but...

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: That was close! Yeah, exactly that!!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
"I was totally planning on just running 
normally! Thanks a bunch, Trainer-poyo☆"

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
I wanna see Ojo, plus Miracle's run is 
gonna be crazy insane for sure!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
"Fr, there's literally no reason NOT to go 
see it!"

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Don't pick up! Thanks in advance!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
choice_data_list:
It's rare to see you not just go with the 
flow

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Let's really trea~sure the vibe I had 
going on that day☆

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, we decided to skip entering any 
races and dedicate the time to training 
and resting.
